rows.grounds: quantifier for the teachings or practitioners
compound: anvaya (lineage) + mārga (path), location of practice
qualifies the lineage path as Kaulika

items.question: Which teachings were previously declared for all within the Kaulika lineage path?
premises: These teachings apply to all practitioners.
The context is the Kaulika lineage path.
items.inference: All previously declared teachings pertain to those situated in the Kaulika lineage path.
uncertainties: Whether sarve qualifies the teachings or the practitioners is contextually ambiguous.
items.plain_english: All that was formerly spoken applies within the Kaulika lineage path.

rows.grounds: compound: sahaja (innate) + ānanda (bliss), object of experience

items.question: What exclusive state of fulfillment characterizes those satisfied by the supreme nectar?
premises: Practitioners are satisfied by supreme nectar.
This bliss is characterized as alone or absolute.
items.inference: Those satisfied by the supreme nectar experience innate bliss alone.
uncertainties: Whether kevalam qualifies sahaja+ānandaṃ as exclusive or indicates a non-dual absolute state.
items.plain_english: Satisfied by the supreme nectar, they experience innate bliss alone.
